description: Client-side script for 'Restaurant Order Entry' form in ERPNext, handling UI interactions, item management, invoice creation, and synchronization.

classes.name: Restaurant Order Entry
classes.description: Client-side form script for managing restaurant orders, including item selection, invoice creation, and table management.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for item query filters.

methods.name: onload_post_render
methods.description: Handles post-render actions, including initializing item selector and input event handling.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Disables save and adds custom buttons for update, clear, and bill actions.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets order form fields and focuses on add item input.

methods.name: restaurant_table
methods.description: Fetches invoice data for selected restaurant table.

methods.name: make_invoice
methods.description: Creates an invoice after syncing, prompts for customer and payment mode.

methods.name: set_invoice_items
methods.description: Sets invoice items and updates totals in the form.
